annotations.title: Weigh Station: find a paid x402 tool

description:
Free. Searches Coinbase's public x402 discovery index for services that do a task (e.g. 'product price lookup', 'send sms', 'web page screenshot'), then checks each result live without paying. Results are ordered by whether they returned a live price quote, then by distinct paying wallets; nobody pays for placement. Descriptions are the sellers' own words.

When to use: You need a paid API for a job and don't know which seller has it. Free.
Use instead: best_x402_tools for a ranking by real repeat buyers; check_service when you already have the URL.
Parameters: query: the job in plain words. limit: how many to check live, default 5.
Returns: matching services, each checked live: whether it answered with a price, the price, network, recipient and paying wallets.

limit.description: How many results to check, default 5.

query.description: What you need done, in plain words.
